info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Offer Acceptance API
info.description: The Loan Offer Acceptance API allows users to formally accept a loan offer linked to a specific loan application. This endpoint facilitates the processing of loan applications by enabling users to confirm their acceptance of the terms provided in the offer. It is typically used by consumers seeking to finalize their loan arrangements and institutional partners managing loan offerings. By using this API, developers can seamlessly integrate acceptance functionalities into their applications, improving the overall customer experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to accept a specific loan application offer identified by its unique reference. Accepting the offer will change its status and proceed with the application process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to accept a specific loan offer associated with a loan application. It should contain the necessary details in JSON format as defined by the schema.
